versions.changelog: 安全修复：增强 HTML 转义防护，所有用户输入和动态内容均经过 escape_html 转义；添加安全说明文档
添加内容类型标注功能：PDF 根据真实新闻/学习材料显示不同徽章和警告框
Fixed PDF generation: restored simple parameter passing
Update cron configuration and improve workflow documentation
Fix metadata: correct required binaries (bash+chrome not node), add explicit dependency documentation, list optional BRAVE_API_KEY, document TTS and Chrome requirements
Add content source labeling (real news vs study material), improve multi-source fallback strategy, add Chinese documentation
Fix security issues (HTML escaping, command injection), add cross-platform Chrome support, add China-based news sources
Documentation cleanup: removed all PingFang font references, updated troubleshooting section
Updated documentation: removed PingFang font dependency, now uses system default fonts
Updated font settings to use system defaults instead of PingFang

- Initial release of the English Daily Report skill.
- Generate daily English news summaries with Chinese translations and vocabulary notes.
- Automatically create PDF and audio (MP3) versions for offline study.
- Includes manual and automated (cron-based) workflows for daily delivery.
- Provides sample scripts and file structure for easy setup and customization.
